description: Integration module to wire retention_sweeper.py into the assessment_scheduler. retention_sweeper.py exists (built 2026-04-19) but is not integrated. Must add cron-style trigger in assessment_scheduler that calls retention_sweeper every 24h. Must verify sweeper reads evidence_blob columns with age >30 days and filters them in queries (no DELETE on core tables per spec section 4). Must emit heartbeat to service_health.
